lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 1 fix 001: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: US-R1-001 fixed the merge-watch-watching event regression: moved the emit from runMergeWatch (legacy blocking wrapper) into stepMergeWatch on the first poll (pollCount===0), so the production one-step-per-tick path in sidecar.ts now emits the event correctly. Updated events.ts comment and recovery-runbook.md to reflect the new emit site. Added two stepMergeWatch tests: one asserting the event IS emitted on first poll, one asserting it is NOT emitted on subsequent polls. 2197 tests pass, all gates green. Check whether US-R1-002 or other review-round-1 fixes remain.

officialDocsValidated.summary: US-R1-001 is an internal TypeScript fix (merge-watch.ts, events.ts, recovery-runbook.md, tests). No external npm library was introduced or modified.
